# Direct Beam

> High-throughput, browser-to-browser encrypted peer-to-peer batch data pipeline built on WebRTC DataChannels with zero cloud retention.

## Main Resources
- [Direct Beam App](https://directbeam.space/): Core peer-to-peer file transfer and data streaming interface.
- [About & Founder](https://directbeam.space/about): Architectural mission, engineering philosophy, and background of Vishwanth Malla.
- [Technology & Security](https://directbeam.space/#faq-section): DTLS 1.3 encryption, SCTP DataChannels, and zero cloud retention.
- [Pro Lifetime Tier](https://directbeam.space/#pro-pricing): Unlimited peer-to-peer transfers with dedicated high-speed TURN relays.
- [Privacy Model](https://directbeam.space/about#privacy): Complete zero-knowledge, browser-memory streaming with zero server storage.

## Developer & API Endpoints
- [Health Check](https://directbeam.space/healthz): System availability and edge health status.
- [ICE Configuration](https://directbeam.space/api/ice-servers): Real-time STUN and TURN server traversal manifest.
- [Signaling Protocol](https://directbeam.space/socket.io/): WebSocket signaling protocol powered by Cloudflare Workers Durable Objects.
